W.note: Restrained tinted flat-art cards with a real add-to-bag cycle and a sticky bag bar that expands to editable lines, but the 4:5 tiles make each card tall and leave the desktop grid sparse.

X.note: The most complete shop flow (search, filters, sort, sold-out and low-stock states, drawer with totals and free-shipping hint) in a dense grid, though emoji glyphs and shadowed cards read less refined.

Y.note: The tightest and most refined layout, with consistent stroke line art, inline variant and quantity controls, and an always-visible bag with live feedback, but it has no checkout step and the bag sits below the grid on mobile.

Z.note: Card-level stepper and drawer work are solid, but the gradient initial tiles look like placeholders, the tall description cards cost density, and the closed drawer's box-shadow bleeds onto the right edge of the viewport.
